title: 7 Mistakes to Avoid When Learning AI Engineering in 2026
description:
What are the biggest mistakes to avoid when learning AI engineering in 2026? Here are seven: spending too long on theory, ignoring software engineering fundamentals, getting stuck in tutorial hell, learning tools instead of concepts, trying to learn everything at once, never deploying anything, and building projects that never solve real problems. 

AI engineering is an incredible opportunity right now, and it's only growing — but it's a practical field, and the people who succeed are the ones who build real things, not the ones who consume the most content. If you're making some of these, don't worry, it happens to everyone. 

The important thing is to recognize it and adjust.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #learntocode #programming
